telegram.title: Telegram webhook

status.UNREGISTERED: Not registered — messages will not arrive

hint.HEALTHY: Telegram is delivering customer messages to this deployment.
hint.PAUSED: The webhook is correct, but CS_CHANNEL_ENABLED is off. Messages are accepted and then ignored.
hint.UNREGISTERED: Telegram does not know where to deliver. Customers can message and nothing reaches the clinic.
hint.HIJACKED: A bot has exactly one webhook. Another deployment is using the same bot token and has taken the traffic — customer messages are arriving there, not here. Use a separate bot per environment.
hint.DELIVERY_FAILING: Telegram is holding messages because delivery is being refused. Check that the API is reachable from the internet and the secret matches.
hint.NO_DOMAIN: HMS_DOMAIN is not set, so the webhook URL cannot be derived.
hint.NOT_CONFIGURED: No bot token or webhook secret is set for this clinic.

telegram.registerFailed: The webhook could not be registered.
telegram.lastErrorStale: Last error {time}: {message}. Nothing is queued now, so this is a fault that already passed.
